chunks: From him, from Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Mu'awiya ibn Wahb, from Ubayd ibn Zur'arah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

I asked him about a man who divorced his wife while he was ill, until a year passed for that reason. He said: She inherits him if he was in the illness in which he divorced her and did not recover from it.
ai.seo_question: Does a wife inherit from her husband if he divorces her while ill and then dies from that same illness?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies the legal status of 'marad al-maut' (death illness) in Shia jurisprudence, establishing that a divorce pronounced during a specific illness does not take effect if the man dies from that same illness without recovering. This ruling ensures the wife retains her inheritance rights, preventing the husband from using divorce as a means to disinherit her during his final illness. The narration highlights the importance of linking the cause of death to the specific illness in which the divorce occurred to determine its validity.
